scope: Proposition 7.2 (Uniform conditional check bounds) of the manuscript “Quenched SLE₃ Universality for the Weak Random-Bond Ising Model” (preprints/Quenched-SLE3-Universality-for-the-Weak-Random-Bond-Ising-Model-October-5-2026/quenched-sle3-weak-random-bond-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf1578546653fc5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the preceding geometry and step constants. There is ε∗ > 0 such that if the tuned trajectory satisfies supj Xj ≤ ε∗, then, for every check Ti of ratio a and inner radius r ≥ M0sk, EBk,Ti ≤ q0 i + Cboot J(r) X j=k Xj(sj/r)c , (7.14) EB+ k,Ti ≤ q0 i + Cboot J(r) X j=k Xj(sj/r)c + CbootXk−1(sk/r)c (k ≥ 1), (7.15) where J(r) = max{j : M0sj ≤ r}. Both right sides are at most q0 i + τi. The bounds hold uniformly over exterior data, frames, and bulk torus charts, with the suprema interpreted as in (7.8).
